description: GDI-Südhessen: emergency and critical facilities datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GDI-Südhessen. Coverage: GDI-Südhessen. The listing groups 41 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about emergency and critical facilities; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: INSPIRE Rettungswachen Kreis Groß-Gerau; Rettungswachen Main-Taunus-Kreis - AreaOfResponsibility; Rettungswachen Odenwaldkreis - INSPIRE Rettungswachen Odenwaldkreis; Rettungswachen Main-Taunus-Kreis - INSPIRE Rettungswachen Main-Taunus-. Formats seen: WMS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
